1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Finance team is a diverse group of skilled individuals who are passionate about accounting and operations. We work both within our finance function, as well as across different departments within the organization to ensure the preparation of our financial statements are ultimately presented fairly, are materially correct and that processes behind building the financial statements are operating in an efficient manner.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada/US. This position will be for 4 months - January to April 2027.

How we’re using AI today
On the Finance team, we’re using AI to drive productivity, scale insight, and deliver better decision-making across 1Password. AI helps us move faster and sharpen our thinking, from summarizing context and pressure-testing assumptions to turning complex inputs into clear executive-level narratives. We bring AI into our work thoughtfully, improving repeatable workflows while staying accountable for the accuracy, confidentiality, and controls behind every output, creating space to focus on judgement, strategic partnership, and meaningful business outcomes.

What you can expect:

- Process vendor invoices and credit card transactions to support the Accounts Payable (AP) team

- Assist the Accounts Receivable (AR) team by triaging and responding to simple customer emails and preparing check deposit reports

- Contribute to process improvement initiatives and AI automation projects.

- Support the team on special projects

- Provide ad-hoc support to AP, AR and Procurement teams as needed

What we're looking for:

- Confidence: A willingness to take on new challenges, and see them through to completion.

- Humility: You're not afraid to ask "stupid" questions and make mistakes (as long as you learn from them).

- Curiosity: You look for better ways of doing things, even if everyone seems happy with how they are.

- Teamwork: We work together, and succeed as a team!

Bonus points for:

- Intermediate skills in excel and/or google sheets

- Keen interest in technology and systems

- Strong communication skills both written and verbal

- Basic understanding of accounting and finance principles

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. The way we bring those values to life every day is guided by our 1Password Behaviors for Success .

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

🏝 Generous PTO policy - 2.08 days per month (1.5 work weeks per 4 month term)

💖 Company-wide wellness days (1 per quarter)

🌎 Employee-led inclusion and belonging programs and ERGs

🏠 Remote-first environment

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

💡 1Password University access and learning sessions

🥳 Monthly internship events and socials

1Password is part of Team True North , a comprehensive group of Canadian tech firms with performance and growth rates that match the top 1% of companies worldwide – companies with the highest probability of reaching $1 billion in annual revenue. We believe in tech for good, and establishing Canada as a preferred destination for growing careers wherever we can!

You belong here.

What to Expect

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads like datacenters to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.

Job Overview

As an electrical engineer intern, you will be responsible for participating in subsystem architecture design, design and analysis/simulation of subcircuits, ECAD library management, layout, schematic capture and performing component and circuit cost and sourcing analysis. You will work with the EE team developing functional test, bring-up procedures, testing and debugging prototypes.

How You Will Contribute

- Own the role of ECAD librarian creating components and providing reviews of design components.

- Work with the EE team to identify suitable components for designs as well as evaluating and identifying alternate solutions.

- Verify circuit performance through simulation and testing of prototypes, including development and facilitation of test procedures.

- Participate in design reviews and trade-off analysis for sub-system architectures.

- Develop bring-up test plans and FW/SW requirements for new designs, performing testing of prototype hardware and managing test data.

- Test electrical interface integrity across PCBs, sensors, actuators, and communication buses (e.g., CAN, RS-485, Ethernet, LV analog/digital I/O).

- Support validation and bring-up of LV systems during prototype and production builds, including DVT and integration testing.

- Coordinate with firmware, test, and manufacturing teams to ensure proper system behavior, testability, integration, and serviceability.

What You Will Bring

We have a short list of must-have requirements. We prioritize a strong grip on first principles, hands-on skills, and a sense of initiative. Domain-specific knowledge and experience will help determine the career level for each hire.

Must-Have Requirements

- Currently pursuing a bachelors or masters in Electrical Engineering.

- 1+ term of previous internship experience in an EE field or examples of hardware projects you have worked on.

- Experience with circuit simulation and ECAD tools (eg. LTSpice, Altium...).

- Experience with microcontrollers, their peripherals and standard board level communication protocols (I2C, SPI, QSPI, UART, CAN).

- Familiarity with analog circuits, power conversion and power supply topologies.

- Hands-on experience with debugging and testing electrical systems using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and similar tools.

- Passion for learning and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience with LV systems in high-voltage environments

- Familiarity with fieldbus communication protocols like CAN or industrial ethernet.

- Knowledge of EMC and UL/IEC standards.

- Knowledge of IPC standards for PCB design and manufacturing.

- Experience in creating engineering drawings, wiring harness drawings, and related specifications.

- Exposure firmware development and debugging tools.

- Knowledge of failure mode analysis and root cause investigations of electrical systems.

- A portfolio that showcases your passion for electronics.

If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) applies cutting-edge technology to operating a reliable electricity system, managing competitive markets for wholesale electricity, and planning for the Empire State's energy future. The NYISO is seeking two Market Design Interns to support strategic initiatives focused on the evolution of New York's wholesale electricity markets. Interns will contribute to projects that evaluate how market design supports reliability, efficiency, price formation, and long-term investment signals across the electric system.

Working alongside market design professionals, interns will conduct research, perform quantitative analysis, develop analytical tools, and evaluate proposed market enhancements. Project assignments may focus on areas such as capacity market design, reliability analysis, resource accreditation, transmission security, scarcity pricing, operating reserve markets, price formation, and market modeling. - Conduct research and analysis in support of electricity market design initiatives.

- Evaluate market rules, pricing mechanisms, and proposed market enhancements.

- Support projects related to capacity market design, resource accreditation, transmission security, scarcity pricing, operating reserve markets, and price formation.

- Develop analytical tools, models, scripts, or prototypes that support market design efforts.

- Create visualizations and reports that effectively communicate technical findings.

- Document methodologies, assumptions, results, and recommendations.

- Support the development of presentations and materials for internal and external stakeholders.

- Collaborate with subject matter experts across NYISO to gather information and evaluate alternative approaches.

- Present research findings, analytical results, and recommendations to team members and leadership.

Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Economics, Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Public Policy (Energy Concentration), or a related field.

- Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Interest in electricity markets, power systems, market design, energy policy, or reliability planning.

- Coursework in economics, statistics, optimization, power systems, electricity markets, or related disciplines is preferred.

- Experience with data analysis and visualization tools.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

HP IQ is HP’s new AI innovation lab. Combining startup agility with HP’s global scale, we’re building intelligent technologies that redefine how the world works, creates, and collaborates.

We’re assembling a diverse, world-class team—engineers, designers, researchers, and product minds—focused on creating an intelligent ecosystem across HP’s portfolio. Together, we’re developing intuitive, adaptive solutions that spark creativity, boost productivity, and make collaboration seamless.

We create breakthrough solutions that make complex tasks feel effortless, teamwork more natural, and ideas more impactful—always with a human-centric mindset.

By embedding AI advancements into every HP product and service, we’re expanding what’s possible for individuals, organisations, and the future of work.

Join us as we reinvent work, so people everywhere can do their best work.

About the Role

HP IQ's Product Integrity & Developer Productivity team is responsible for building next-generation tools and systems that improve developer productivity and product quality at scale. We are specifically investing in agentic systems that automate complex workflows, from intelligent JIRA triage and root-cause analysis to test planning and quality automation. In this internship role, you will work directly with our hiring manager and team to design, build, and deploy agents that utilize pre-trained machine learning models to solve real problems for developers and quality engineers. This is an exceptional opportunity to be part of a team navigating the fundamental shift toward agentic development and to contribute meaningfully to tools that thousands of developers will rely on.

What You Might Do

As an intern on our team, you'll contribute to real-world engineering projects that explore how AI can improve the way software is built, tested, and maintained. Depending on business priorities and your team's needs, you may have the opportunity to:

- Design, build, and iterate on AI-powered tools and workflows that improve engineering productivity.

- Develop intelligent systems that help automate software development, testing, debugging, or quality assurance processes.

- Prototype and evaluate new approaches for applying large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI to solve complex engineering challenges.

- Collaborate with software engineers, machine learning engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners to deliver impactful solutions.

- Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving sessions.

- Analyze technical challenges, propose innovative solutions, and contribute fresh ideas that improve products, tools, and engineering workflows.

- Build, test, and iterate on production-quality software while learning modern engineering best practices.

- Present your work, share technical learnings, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.

Essential Qualifications

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- Solid understanding of coding fundamentals and comfort with at least one programming language; you should be able to learn new languages and frameworks as needed.

- Familiarity with agentic systems, AI tools (such as Claude Code or OpenAI), or model utilization in applications; deep machine learning expertise is not required as we focus on using pre-trained models, not building them.

- Ability to break down complex problems into manageable steps and solve them independently while knowing when to ask for help.

- Willingness to question established processes and propose alternative approaches; comfort in an environment that values fresh thinking and continuous improvement.

- Strong communication skills; ability to explain your reasoning clearly and articulate the logic behind your technical choices.

- Familiarity with software development workflows, quality assurance, testing practices, or developer tooling (helpful but not required).

Preferred Skills

- Experience building or working with automation tools or systems that improve workflow efficiency.

- Exposure to or familiarity with JIRA, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems, or testing frameworks.

- Experience working in cross-functional teams or in environments where you collaborated with people from different technical backgrounds.

- Understanding or coursework in machine learning, AI, or agent systems.

- Example projects demonstrating agentic thinking, such as personal projects using AI tools to automate tasks.

Your Role:

- Job Description: Robotics Data Operator Intern

- Category: Robotics / AI Data Operator

- Location: LA, US

As the Intern of the Robotics Data Factory, you will be responsible for collecting high-fidelity human behavior and robot teleoperation data. This data is essential for training the next generation of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, helping robots learn to perceive and interact with the physical world by capturing real-world human interactions and precision robotic movements.

Key Responsibilities

- Egocentric Data Collection: Wear designated head-mounted recording devices (e.g., smartphone rigs, GoPro, or head-mounted VR kits) to capture daily or industrial tasks from a first-person perspective in diverse environments (home, retail, or manufacturing).

- VR Teleoperation: Operate robotic systems via VR interfaces to perform complex manipulation tasks. Ensure high-quality capture of multi-modal data, including joint states, torques, and gripper status, while maintaining low-latency execution.

- Technical Specification Compliance: Maintain strict recording standards (1080p, 30FPS, horizontal orientation, FOV >130°). Ensure accurate extraction of camera intrinsic parameters and time-synchronization across all sensors.

- Quality Assurance & Pre-processing: Conduct initial self-inspections to filter out clips with excessive shaking, occlusions, or focus failures. Ensure data is correctly formatted (e.g., MCAP, HDF5) and uploaded according to protocol.

Basic Qualifications:

- Experience: 0–1 years of experience. Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

- Extreme Attention to Detail: Ability to strictly follow complex technical guidelines regarding framing, motion rhythm, and lighting environments.

- Technical Proficiency: Comfortable using smartphones, VR hardware (Meta Quest/HTC Vive), and various digital accessories. Basic understanding of video recording parameters and calibration.

- Action Consistency: Ability to perform tasks naturally while maintaining the specific "robotic-friendly" pacing required for imitation learning.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience in Python, Linux command line.

- Familiarity with ROS2, LeRobot, or AI data labeling workflows.

- Strong interest in Embodied AI and robotics.

Work Environment & Restrictions:

- Glove Policy: Preference for bare hands; if necessary, only approved thin/transparent medical gloves are allowed. No thick or dark-colored gloves that obscure finger articulation.

- Safety & Privacy: Must follow all site-specific safety protocols and strictly avoid capturing any Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or sensitive/prohibited scenarios.

Perks + Benefits

- Casual dress code + relaxed work environment

- Culturally diverse, progressive atmosphere

Why Plot

Plot is building the next generation of social intelligence — an AI-native platform that helps some of the world's most influential brands understand culture, find emerging trends, and activate their communities at scale. We're a high-growth, venture-backed startup supported by the co-founders of Reddit and Plaid, with customers like Tory Burch, Lululemon, La Roche-Posay, and other household names.

We operate at the frontier of applied AI and agentic systems, ingesting and reasoning over millions of short-form videos to uncover consumer insights no one else can see. Our work impacts real product decisions, global marketing campaigns, and how brands engage their fans.

You'll join a small experienced team where engineers ship product — not tickets. You'll work hand-in-hand with our product designer from day one, shaping features before specs exist and turning rough ideas into shipped experiences. You'll work directly with founders, hop on customer calls, and own company-defining features end-to-end. If you want real responsibility, fast learning loops, and the ability to shape both product and company, Plot is the place. It's also a perfect fit if you aspire to build your own startup one day — we operate with a deep founder's mindset.

What You'll Work On

- Build agentic, reasoning-driven systems on top of cutting-edge LLMs to power consumer intelligence, marketing automation, and influencer activation.

- Collaborate deeply with product design to prototype, iterate, and ship AI features from 0→1. You'll be in Figma reviews, whiteboarding sessions, and user interviews — not just implementing handed-down specs.

- Design & execute LLM/ML evaluation frameworks — from offline benchmarks to live A/B tests — to measure quality, reliability, and business impact.

- Own full-stack AI product features: prompt design, orchestration, tooling, monitoring, and the UX that brings it all together.

- Collaborate closely with founders, design, marketing, and customers to ensure our AI deliver real customer value

- Stay at the front of the curve: research, prototype, and integrate emerging methods in agentic reasoning, context engineering, and LLM-driven automation.

- Note: This role is not focused on training foundation models — it's about building high-leverage systems on top of them (think "Claude-Code over Claude-Model").

What We're Looking For

- Proven track record shipping customer-facing products. You've built features users love and can move quickly across the entire stack — frontend, backend, infrastructure.

- Deep, hands-on familiarity with LLMs — evaluation, prompt engineering, tool use, context management, and agentic workflows. You stay current with the latest advances in AI and are excited to experiment with new techniques and apply them to real product problems.

- Strong product sense and design instinct. You have opinions about what makes AI experiences great — and what makes them terrible. You're comfortable working with designers in the earliest stages, before the UX is settled, to collaboratively shape what the product should be. You can wear multiple hats: engineer, product thinker, and user advocate.

- High ownership mindset. You like talking to users, debugging real data, reading logs, and doing the unglamorous work required to build great AI products.

- Curiosity, grit, and a drive to build things that feel like magic. No degree requirements.

Purpose:

The TDS Proteins Development API organization is seeking highly motivated Co-Op candidates to support Upstream Process Development initiatives focused on mammalian cell culture, bioreactor process development, process modeling, advanced data analytics, and manufacturing scale-down models.

This opportunity provides hands-on experience supporting the development and optimization of CHO cell culture processes, dynamic feeding strategies, media and process parameter studies, product quality assessments, and automated high-throughput bioreactor systems. Co-Ops will collaborate with scientists, engineers, and internal and external partners to generate, analyze, and interpret data that advance upstream process understanding, scalability, productivity, and manufacturing readiness.

You will be responsible:

- Developing correlations between real-time biocapacitance signals and offline viable cell density measurements across different CHO cell lines and media conditions.
- Supporting the development and implementation of dynamic feeding strategies that adjust nutrient feed rates based on real-time cell density measurements.
- Evaluating the impact of media components, feeding strategies, and process parameters on cell culture performance and product quality attributes, including titer, viability, productivity, and galactosylation.
- Supporting development and characterization of small-scale models that represent manufacturing-scale cell culture processes.
- Comparing small-scale and manufacturing-scale process performance to identify conditions that support appropriate process representation and scalability.
- Performing advanced analytics on historical and experimental process and spent-media datasets to identify actionable insights.
- Developing and applying mechanistic, data-driven, or hybrid models to explain and predict process outcomes such as end-of-run titer and cell-specific productivity.
- Designing experiments informed by model outputs, process knowledge, and statistical design principles.
- Analyzing, visualizing, interpreting, and presenting experimental results using analytical and statistical techniques.
- Participating in technical discussions, design of experiments, and problem-solving activities to address knowledge gaps.
- Collaborating with internal and external partners and actively participating in recurring project meetings.
- Maintaining laboratory notebooks, technical reports, datasets, and other documentation in accordance with established guidelines.
- Providing additional laboratory, analytical, and project support as needed.

- Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills are required.
- Ability to analyze complex experimental or process data and draw data-driven conclusions.
- Ability to balance multiple projects and priorities while delivering results.

- Experience with bioreactor operations and upstream process development principles.
- Strong analytical, quantitative, and statistical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience or exposure in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

Cell Culture & Bioprocessing:

- Experience with fed-batch and/or perfusion cell culture processes.

About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About the Ground Systems Deployment Team

The Ground Systems Deployment and Construction team is responsible for turning bare ground into functional drone charging sites! We’re a broad, cross-functional team with skills across civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and construction engineering with a mandate to deliver world-class construction execution with zero issues in the first 30 days, on-time and on-budget, using scalable, cost-optimized, and serviceable designs.

The Role

The Ground System Deployment and Construction Engineering team is seeking a curious, collaborative Electrical Engineering Intern to support the design and deployment of Zipline’s Ground Systems across a variety of sites and applications.

In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience with commercial and light-industrial electrical distribution as applied to an autonomous drone delivery network. Working alongside experienced engineers, you’ll help with utility coordination, site-level electrical design, structure-level wiring approaches, and technical documentation.

You’ll collaborate with mechanical, structural, electrical, and deployments teams to support real-world projects and contribute to problem-solving as new challenges arise. This internship also offers opportunities to explore new design ideas and assist with improvements to our engineering processes. You’ll work and become familiar with the National Electrical Code and apply the concepts to site and infrastructure designs.

The internship is based in South San Francisco, with occasional travel within California and the U.S. for site visits or field support.

What You'll Do

- Support engineers with research, drafting, and documentation for electrical distribution and structure-level wiring designs aligned with NEC and relevant standards.

- Assist with UL/TUV certification efforts by gathering documentation, preparing technical materials, and coordinating with engineering partners.

- Help prepare materials, track communication, and support interactions with deployment and construction teams

- Implement feedback from Deployment and Construction teams to continuously optimize designs for more efficient build and scale

- Design electrical distribution of commercial and light industrial ground system projects per NEC and relevant applicable codes and standards.

- Design next generation charging structure level electrical wiring and installation approaches.

- Evaluate all options and a lean budget, select best vendors to ensure reliable and quality services and products.

- Help document project risks, prepare materials for meetings, support communication across teams, and occasionally participate in site visits for field observations.

- Create documentation to ensure quality and process refinement between each build to help with consistent scale

- Collaborate with engineering and business teams to understand customer needs and contribute to improvements in Ground Systems infrastructure.

- Travel to commercial and flight test sites may be required on an ad hoc basis.

What You'll Bring

- You must have completed the second year of your undergraduate studies, with relevant coursework (e.g., circuits, power systems, construction). Master's and PhD students are also eligible.

- Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to ask questions and learn.

- Familiarity with engineering tools or concepts such as CAD/ECAD, electrical modeling, or basic simulation software. (Revit, Bluebeam Revu, AutoCAD, NX)

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, especially when summarizing technical information.

- Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment and support a wide range of tasks.

- Curiosity, initiative, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Comfort with hands-on work and openness to occasional travel (if needed).

- An open mind to help us bring Zipline’s service to new and existing customers!

About Axos

Born digital-first, Axos delivers financial tools and services that allow individuals, small businesses, and companies to access and manage their money how, when, and where they want. We’re a diverse team of dynamic, insightful, and independent innovators who are excited to provide technology-driven solutions that offer unbeatable value to our customers.

Axos Financial is our holding company and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "AX" (NYSE: AX).

Pre-Employment Background Check and Drug Test:

All offers are contingent upon the candidate successfully passing a credit check, criminal background check, and pre-employment drug screening, which includes screening for marijuana. Axos Bank is a federally regulated banking institution. At the federal level, marijuana is an illegal schedule 1 drug; therefore, we will not employ any person who tests positive for marijuana, regardless of state legalization.
